episodes.title: Exposing the Cult I Grew Up In: The CMRI and Sedevacantism Refuted — Part 1
episodes.description:
I grew up in the CMRI — the Congregation of Mary Immaculate Queen. For most of my life, I believed they were the one true Catholic Church.
This is what I found out when I started digging. I left the "church" around when I turned 19.
In this video I cover the full history of the CMRI, from its founding by Francis Schuckardt in 1967, through the SWAT raids, the lawsuits, the covered-up sexual abuse, and the revolt that brought the whole thing down. I also look at the organization as it exists today, and ask a question most members have never been allowed to ask:
Is this still a cult?
Part 1 covers the founding, the early years, and the documented abuse that the organization has never publicly acknowledged.
Sources and documentation available on request.
